name: Emotional cinematic arrangement arc: background-only subtle intro, gradual additions, a climax built first where the melody appears, gentle fade outro, melody derived from chord arpeggios, light master chain
goal: Build a warm, nostalgic cinematic piece around a familiar chord progression played by piano, strings, choir, bells/celesta and harp. Arc: start from a very subtle, transparent warmth that appears from nowhere; keep a background with no certain melody; add instruments little by little; one-note tremolo 'angelic wind' swell from a soft lead with volume automation (octave-up double); a climax where all emotion and melody goes (you can write it first and build the other parts around it); strings that fade vibrato in rather than starting vibrating immediately; an outro that fades continuously to nowhere with a final legato fade and a single-note cymbal swell. Melody method: write the chord progression, arpeggiate chord notes forward/backward on piano, loop ~10 rounds, then edit notes.

Master with moderate settings: avoid extreme settings.

steps.action: Choose the chord progression and palette: piano (with a reverse/una-corda-style setting for airy sound), strings, choir, bells/celesta, harp.
Write a background without a defined melody; start intro as quiet, transparent warmth that seems to appear from nowhere and everything slowly rises.
Add instruments little by little; use a one-note soft lead swell with tremolo and volume automation (plus an octave-up double) as an 'angelic wind' appearing effect.
Climax: put the melody here and all emotion; build it first if useful and then build the other parts around it. Fade vibrato into sustained strings gradually.
steps.expect: Climax is the only section with melody.

steps.action: Outro: fade out constantly and end on a legato string fade, a single-note cymbal swell and a short piano dialogue.
Make melodies from chords: play chord-note arpeggios (forward, backward, improvise), loop about 10 rounds, then edit notes in the piano roll to smooth the line.
Master lightly: high-pass at 20 Hz, a little saturation, a mastering preset tweaked toward middle settings, a limiter and a level meter.

verification: Melody is absent before the climax and present in it.
Outro level declines continuously to silence.
